plans.idea: Keep the original's left-to-right logic as a two-column square: a large bottle fills the left column, and the right column stacks headline, subcopy, badges and the CTA on one shared left edge, with legal text across the bottom.

A centred top-to-bottom poster stack: the headline and subcopy span the top, the bottle sits in the middle as the focal image, the badges sit just under the product they describe, and the CTA anchors the bottom above the legal line.
Lead with the product: a big bottle across the top half, then a two-column footer with headline, subcopy and badges on the left and a strong CTA block on the right, both aligned to the same top line.
